description: Move a page under a different `parent`, rename its `slug`, or both. Its whole subtree travels with it and every old path redirects, so links into the section keep working - tidying the tree never rots a link. The page's id never changes, so anything citing the id is unaffected.

page.description: page is the page's id or its full path within the wiki.

parent.description:
parent is the page to move under - an id or a path. Omit to leave it where
 it is and only rename.

slug.description: slug is the page's new path segment. Omit to leave the name alone.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

wiki.description: wiki is the wiki the page is in - its id or slug.

name: move_page
title: Move page
